title: Cellforge
description: A multi-sheet spreadsheet with a from-scratch formula engine — hand-written lexer, Pratt parser, evaluator, and one live dependency graph with topological recalc + cycle detection. NEW v9 — a FINANCIAL-MODELING engine built from first principles: the full TIME VALUE OF MONEY family off the annuity master equation (PV/FV/PMT/NPER/RATE, the IPMT/PPMT per-period split and CUMIPMT/CUMPRINC), DISCOUNTED CASH FLOW (NPV, IRR, the calendar-accurate XNPV/XIRR, reinvestment-aware MIRR) with a guarded Newton + bisection rate finder, and DEPRECIATION (SLN/SYD/DB/DDB and the switch-aware VDB) — a flagship three-sheet Finance Lab amortizes a loan to −$0.00 in one MAKEARRAY, values a project four ways, and depreciates an asset four ways at once. On top of v8's INFERENTIAL STATISTICS (T.TEST/Z.TEST/F.TEST/χ² test) + a SPECTRAL layer (Jacobi eigen, one-sided-Jacobi SVD, QR eigenvalues, Moore–Penrose pseudo-inverse); v7's REGRESSION (LINEST's full stats block off a Householder QR) + dense MATRIX ALGEBRA + statistical DISTRIBUTIONS; v6's MIXED-INTEGER PROGRAMMING + SENSITIVITY REPORT; v5's SIMPLEX Solver; v4's spill-range refs (A1#), pivots, recursive lambdas; v3's dynamic arrays, LAMBDA/LET + MAP/REDUCE and Goal Seek; cross-sheet refs, named ranges, undo/redo, Excel dates, ~275 functions, draggable SVG charts and find & replace. 356 in-app engine self-tests.
